comparison.objective: Prepare a moka pot by filling below the safety valve and screwing the top on snugly.
comparison.physical_skill: Liquid-level control, component handling, threaded engagement, and torque-limited closure.
comparison.success_condition: Correct water level, assembled pot snug but not over-tightened, with no spill or unsafe valve obstruction.
comparison.reason: Tests filling and threaded vessel assembly. It does not exercise continuous rolling-element support, rail/jig seam control, or ball-loss avoidance.
